product_brief.brief_description: Create a clean label dairy-free cheese style spread containing at least 6% protein, smooth knife-spreadable texture, and fermented savory umami notes. Requires 60-day refrigerated stability, natural yellow color, and cost under 9.5 USD/kg. Strictly exclude dairy milk, casein, and synthetic preservatives.
